g.text: ARTIFICIAL ELECTRICAL LOADS ONLY / FIRST MONITORING SLICE

g.desc: ARTIFICIAL ELECTRICAL LOADS ONLY / FIRST MONITORING SLICE

g.text: No current driver, HV router, differential compliance circuit, independent watchdog, MCU or PCB is completed here.

g.desc: No current driver, HV router, differential compliance circuit, independent watchdog, MCU or PCB is completed here.

g.text: CLRN = HI_OK AND LO_OK AND EXT_SUP_OK. Any low latches Q off; rising REARM admits only while CLRN is high.

g.desc: CLRN = HI_OK AND LO_OK AND EXT_SUP_OK. Any low latches Q off; rising REARM admits only while CLRN is high.

g.text: Q=-10k*22n/40*(V_end-V_start); 600nC=109.091mV nominal. Take BASELINE, CATH, ANODE, NET/TAIL endpoints.

g.desc: Q=-10k*22n/40*(V_end-V_start); 600nC=109.091mV nominal. Take BASELINE, CATH, ANODE, NET/TAIL endpoints.

g.text: Cathodic and anodic charges remain separate. Opposed phases can cancel: final net alone cannot qualify delivery.

g.desc: Cathodic and anodic charges remain separate. Opposed phases can cancel: final net alone cannot qualify delivery.

g.text: Actual current-tail/window evidence is required. Command edges, the comparator or an ideal16-bit LSB do not certify precision.

g.desc: Actual current-tail/window evidence is required. Command edges, the comparator or an ideal16-bit LSB do not certify precision.
